title: Infrared Spectroscopy
description: Each bond swallows its own colour of infrared: the gaps in the light are a list of the bonds. Unlocks the Infrared Spectrometer and Structure Cards.

puzzle.goal: A bond of stiffness k joins two atoms of masses a and b. Write its vibration frequency v in hertz.
puzzle.name: Harmonic bond
puzzle.form: sqrt ( k * ( a + b ) / ( a * b ) ) / ( 2 * π )
puzzle.ask: Find v for a C=O bond: k = @{k} N/m, a = @{a} kg, b = @{b} kg.
puzzle.method: A spring between two masses vibrates as one of the reduced mass ab/(a + b).
